state.title: Migrate invoice PDF generation from wkhtmltopdf to headless Chromium
state.body: wkhtmltopdf is unmaintained and breaks with the new CSS grid layouts. This swaps the renderer to a Chromium sidecar. Output is byte-for-byte different but visually identical in our 40 golden-file tests (regenerated). Adds ~180 MB to the container image. Rollback: set PDF_RENDERER=legacy.

instructions.task: Rate how ready this PR is to merge.

criteria.definition: Failing CI, no tests, or unresolved design questions.
Passes CI but lacks evidence for a risky change or has no rollback path.
Mergeable; reviewer should note follow-ups (docs, image size, monitoring).

instructions: Pick the single area most affected by this PR.
Use files_changed as the primary signal and the body as a tiebreaker.

rendering.covers: PDF/HTML rendering pipeline, fonts, layout engines.

infrastructure.covers: Dockerfiles, sidecars, resource limits, deployment manifests.
infrastructure.does_not_cover: Application code that happens to live in the same PR.

ops_impact.instructions: Will operators need to do something (capacity, monitoring, runbooks) when this ships?

true.covers: New sidecar or process, image size or memory changes, new env vars, new failure modes.

false.covers: Pure application logic with the same runtime footprint.

needs_changelog.instructions: Should this change be mentioned in the user-facing changelog?

instructions.task: How many reviewers should this PR get?
instructions.hint: Use risk and breadth of files_changed.

criteria.two: Two reviewers: the change is risky or cross-cutting.
criteria.three_plus: Needs a wider review or an RFC.
